_comment: Bandwidth ceilings measured by tools/kernel_gate/bandwidth_probe*. Rewrite by re-running the probes, never by hand.
_machine: GTX 1650 4 GiB (spec 192 GB/s), i5-11300H, DDR4 dual channel, 15 GiB RAM
notes: The GPU read kernel reaches 98% of the card's spec bandwidth, so the spec sheet is a fair ceiling for GPU work.
Decode on the 1.5B Q4_K_M model moves 1.117 GB per token: 104.42 t/s is 116.6 GB/s, i.e. 62% of gpu_read_gbs.
kernel-gate's 4096x4096 Q4_K weight is 9.4 MB against 8 MB of L3, so part of its 65 GB/s is cache; a DRAM-resident comparison needs a ~1 GB weight.
